semantic.justification: Task173 creates actual core SfxStyleSheetBase/SfxStyleSheetBasePool owners and native style hints, reusing SfxBroadcaster/Listener, IndexedStyleSheets, SfxStyleSheetIterator, registered SfxItemPool ranges and actual SfxItemSet. Preserve original field defaults, stable OUString members, name/parent/follow validation, nonvirtual child rename, optional reindex, mask/hidden/help/usage fields, owned versus borrowed set copy and by-value preview. Pool factories/search/cache/insertion/removal/reparent/copy/assignment/clear and derived/base Dying order follow the represented source. Native lifetime/WeakImplHelper allocation is erased under JS GC; bMySet remains solely for set-copy semantics and explicit destructor boundary, not a refcount manager. Core classes implement no UNO XComponent; component query/dispose extension, presentation/XML and derived SfxStyleSheet/ScStyleSheet remain absent rather than stubbed. Preserve CALC146/150 and core copy owner/creation/replacement quirks CALC152..154. Full document/connected UI/same-model ODS and whole-class/module parity are not claimed.
